ava-baidu-1.webp.zh: 安顺黄果树机场航站楼外景：流线型屋顶上立着红色「黄果树」大字，广场前车辆稀少。
ava-baidu-1.webp.en: The terminal of Anshun Huangguoshu Airport, the red '黄果树' characters on its sweeping roof, an almost empty forecourt below.

ava-baidu-2.webp.zh: 黄昏时分的航站楼与塔台：路边广告牌写着「21℃的城市」，塔台在暮色中亮着灯。
ava-baidu-2.webp.en: The terminal and tower at dusk — a roadside billboard reading '21℃的城市' with the control tower lit against the evening sky.

ava-baidu-3.webp.zh: 旅客走出航站楼登上飞机：塔台之下是金色「黄果树」店招与玻璃幕墙，人们在机坪上步行登机。
ava-baidu-3.webp.en: Passengers walking out to board — the gilded '黄果树' sign and glazed frontage behind them, the tower overhead.

ava-chatgpt-01.webp.zh: 晴空下的航站楼：银色曲面屋顶上方立着红色大字，玻璃幕墙前车道空旷。
ava-chatgpt-01.webp.en: Under a clear sky, the terminal's silver curved roof carries large red characters above a glass frontage and empty roadway.

ava-chatgpt-02.webp.zh: 鸟瞰新航站楼：塔台立在左侧，跑道横在屋顶后方，前方停车场排着新栽的树木。
ava-chatgpt-02.webp.en: Aerial view of the new terminal, the control tower at left, the runway behind its roof and neat rows of young trees in the car park.

ava-chatgpt-03.webp.zh: 雨天里，旅客沿着印有机场名称的带篷舷梯登机，机坪地面湿漉反光。
ava-chatgpt-03.webp.en: On a wet, overcast day, passengers climb covered airstairs painted with the airport's name while the apron shines with rain.

ava-chatgpt-04.webp.zh: 米色外墙的老航站楼配着红色檐口，塔台在后方耸起，门前车道边立着一排石球。
ava-chatgpt-04.webp.en: A cream-walled older terminal with red-trimmed canopies, the control tower rising behind and white bollards along its driveway.
